description: Oleodutos | vw_infra_dutovia_oldt is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Feições lineares que representam as dutovias. Fonte dos dados: Infra S.A./Ministério dos Transportes. Dados públicos obtidos na internet ( Camada de Dutovias do Ministério da Infraestrutura classificadas em: AQUADUTO', 'GASODUTO', 'MINERODUTO', 'OLEODUTO'. Oleodutos de transporte movimentam petróleo, seus derivados e biocombustíveis em meio ou percurso considerado de interesse geral. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Oleoduto, Infraestutura de dutos, Transporte de petróleo, Brazil, transportation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
